title: I could not find what I was looking for a item is not an clickable
body:

comments.body: Could you explain what you mean? If you want a way to go to a detail page from a result, you can simply add a link to that result in the item template. Does that make sense?
@roshandhabekar can you give us more details on what you're trying to achieve?
@roshandhabekar I'm closing this issue for now. Please open a new one if you have more details :)
